bosses.name: The Starving
bosses.effect: -1 hand size. Every turn you draw one less die. (Turn 1 -1 die, turn 2 -2 dice, etc.)
bosses.empowered: -2 hand size. Every turn you draw one less die. (Turn 1 -1 die, turn 2 -2 dice, etc.)

bosses.name: The Odd
bosses.effect: 2X Multiplier to dice with an odd face. 0X to dice with an even face.
bosses.empowered: 0X to dice with an even face.

bosses.name: The Even
bosses.effect: 2X Multiplier to dice with an even face. 0X to dice with an odd face.
bosses.empowered: 0X to dice with an odd face.

bosses.name: The Modest
bosses.effect: Deactivate the effects of half of your rings every roll.
bosses.empowered: Deactivate the effects of almost all of your rings every roll.

bosses.name: The Greedy
bosses.effect: The objective is extra high.
bosses.empowered: The objective is extra EXTRA high.

bosses.name: The Capricious
bosses.effect: Dice deactivate until the end of round once they are rolled.
bosses.empowered: Dice rolled and dice left on your hand deactivate until the end of round.

bosses.name: The Pyro
bosses.effect: After each roll, places a fire that will burn VERY nearby dice.
bosses.empowered: After each roll, places a fire that will burn VERY nearby dice. Starts with a fire already out.

bosses.name: The Frost
bosses.effect: Freezes the face of all your dice to their lowest.
bosses.empowered: Freezes the face of all your dice to their lowest. Then, deactivates every die you rolled until the end of the round.

bosses.name: The Envious
bosses.effect: Any die that rolls its highest face is discarded.
bosses.empowered: Permanently destroys the die that rolled the highest face.(In case of draw, a random one is chosen.)

bosses.name: The Heretic
bosses.effect: Reduces everything by -10% for every enchanted die in your bag. (To a maximum of 80%.)
bosses.empowered: You cannot use cards. Reduces everything by -10% for every enchanted die in your bag.(To a maximum of 80%.)

bosses.name: The Sloth
bosses.effect: Draw 3 less dice. One less roll.
bosses.empowered: Draw 5 less dice. One less roll.

bosses.name: The Hollow
bosses.effect: Every roll adds 2 hollow dice to your bag. (These don't do anything and will destroy themselves when rolled.)
bosses.empowered: Every roll adds 5 hollow dice to your bag. (These don't do anything and will destroy themselves when rolled.)

bosses.name: The Hermit
bosses.effect: Reduces the range of every area effect to its minimum. Charged dice cannot gain charges.
bosses.empowered: Charged dice and dice with area effects are deactivated.

bosses.name: The Negative
bosses.effect: Divides by half the value of every multiplier greater or equals to 3.
bosses.empowered: Divides by half the value of every multiplier greater or equals to 2.

bosses.name: The Blackout
bosses.effect: Every die is hidden until rolled. Only their silhouette is visible.
bosses.empowered: Every die is hidden until rolled. Only their silhouette is visible. -1 hand size.

bosses.name: The Glutton
bosses.effect: 0X Multiplier to everything if you roll less than your hand size. Not rolled dice will be exhausted.
bosses.empowered: 0X Multiplier to everything if you roll less than your hand size. Not rolled dice will be exhausted. Also exhausts one random die you rolled.

bosses.name: The Cautious
bosses.effect: Extra value subtracts instead of adding. Every roll adds +1 extra value to every die in your bag.
bosses.empowered: Extra value subtracts instead of adding. Every roll adds +2 extra value to every die in your bag.

bosses.name: The Serpentine
bosses.effect: Every other roll, gives 0X Multiplier to everything.
bosses.empowered: Every other roll, gives 0X Multiplier and exhausts everything.

bosses.name: The Witch
bosses.effect: Every turn you'll need to roll one specific face. If you don't, curses one of the dice you rolled.
bosses.empowered: Every turn you'll need to roll one specific face. If you don't, curses every dice you rolled.

bosses.name: The Dusty
bosses.effect: Every die has a small explosive area effect, that will discard VERY nearby dice.
bosses.empowered: Every die has an explosive area effect, that will discard nearby dice.

bosses.name: The Sixth
bosses.effect: Dice with face greater than 6 are negative. (They will subtract instead of adding)
bosses.empowered: Dice with face equals or greater than 6 are negative. (They will subtract instead of adding)

bosses.name: The Patient
bosses.effect: Half of your dice are deactivated until you roll them once.
bosses.empowered: Half of your dice are deactivated until you roll them once. One less roll.

bosses.name: The Copycat
bosses.effect: Any dice with a repeated face is divided by the number of dice with that face.
bosses.empowered: Any dice with a repeated face is multiplied by 0.

bosses.name: The Boss
bosses.effect: Rolls his own dice.

enemyDice.name: Alpha
enemyDice.effect: Subtracts the value on its face. (Can be multiplied.)

enemyDice.name: Beta
enemyDice.effect: Subtracts the value on its face. (Can be multiplied.)

enemyDice.name: Gamma
enemyDice.effect: Divides the value of your dice by the number on its face.

enemyDice.name: Delta
enemyDice.effect: Subtracts 1 per nearby die. (Can be multiplied.)

enemyDice.name: Lambda
enemyDice.effect: Extra value of nearby dice is reduced to 0.

enemyDice.name: Xi
enemyDice.effect: Divides by 4 the value of nearby dice.

enemyDice.name: Iota
enemyDice.effect: Adds X Hollow Dice to your bag. X being the number on its face.

enemyDice.name: Omega
enemyDice.effect: Transforms VERY nearby dice rolled by you into Hollow Dice.

enemyDice.name: Epsilon
enemyDice.effect: Subtracts the sum of all extra value from dice on the table.

enemyDice.name: Tau
enemyDice.effect: Every die whose face is greater than this one's, is worth 0.

enemyDice.name: Omicron
enemyDice.effect: If its face shows it, places a fire that will burn VERY nearby dice in next rolls.

enemyDice.name: Psi
enemyDice.effect: Rolls negative copies of dice left in your hand. (These will subtract their score and won't activate any effects.)

enemyDice.name: Rho
enemyDice.effect: Adds a curse to nearby dice.

enchantments.name: Loyalty
enchantments.effect: 1 in 2 probability of going back to hand after it's rolled.

enchantments.name: Eternal
enchantments.effect: Can't be destroyed nor discarded on the table. Can't be exhausted either.

enchantments.name: Laconism
enchantments.effect: Doesn't take any space in hand when selected.

enchantments.name: Perennial
enchantments.effect: Only loses half of its extra value after the round ends.

enchantments.name: Negative
enchantments.effect: Its value subtracts instead of adding.

enchantments.name: Weak
enchantments.effect: Divides in half every mult. equal or greater to 2X that it would give or recieve.

enchantments.name: Deciduous
enchantments.effect: Extra value subtracts instead of adding.

enchantments.name: Parasite
enchantments.effect: When rolled adds a Hollow Die to your bag.

enchantments.name: Gilded
enchantments.effect: The effects of this ring will be doubled.
